behavior.trigger: A committed positive LP gain event is consumed once by each eligible Fire Princess controlled by the gaining team.
behavior.amountScaling: Damage is per copy and event, not per 500 LP gained.
behavior.teamRouting: Damage is applied to the opposing team's shared LP.
behavior.physicalOwnership: Physical owner seat is derived from the stable m0..m3 UID prefix and retained separately from controller team.
behavior.negation: Current continuous monster-effect negation is checked through monsterEffectsNegated; per-copy chain-negation UIDs are supplied by the trusted chain resolver.
behavior.idempotency: Event ledger prevents repeated damage after an atomic commit; duplicate retries return the current LP tuple unchanged.
behavior.mutation: Adapter is read-only; caller must atomically commit the returned LP tuple and event ledger.

validation.build: npm run check && npm run build
validation.discord: offline TagDuel adapter contract only; no live gateway test

limitations: Does not register Fire Princess in monsterEffects.ts or duelEngineCurrent.ts.
LP gain event must be emitted by the trusted resolver after the gain is committed.
Per-copy chain-negation UID snapshot must be captured by the trusted chain context.
No catalog admission, certification, inventory grant, persistent DB write, player-data write, live Discord test, merge or deployment.

ownerRules.deck: 20-30 cards at construction; adapter rejects a live deck above 30 but does not impose a minimum after draws
